summary: Called date-validation utility subroutine. Given a date and a date format in its linkage area, it uses the Language Environment date services (CEEDAYS / CEEDATE) to check whether the date is a valid calendar date in the given format, and returns a result/severity code to the caller. Shared date-edit helper used by the online and batch programs.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the input date and its format from the linkage area. Call the LE service CEEDAYS to convert the date to a Lilian day number using the supplied picture; if the conversion severity indicates a bad date, return a 'date invalid' result, otherwise return 'date valid' (optionally reformatting via CEEDATE). Return to the caller.
branches: IF CEEDAYS feedback severity <> 0 -> date invalid ELSE valid

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a date is valid only if the LE CEEDAYS conversion succeeds for the given format; returns a validity/severity code to the caller.

paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS-CRITICAL: the shared date-validity check used across the app.

paragraphs.name: SET-RESULT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Map the LE feedback code to the caller's result field (valid / invalid / severity) and return.
